subject: Procurement portal refresh + capacity uplift — sprint kickoff
messages:
From: Marcy Lewis <marcy.lewis@acmehealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal procurement: portal refresh + timeline

Hi Stephanie,

We're getting close to our contract renewal window for the Redwood account (effective 2028-07-01). Procurement at Acme wants to ensure vendor onboarding artifacts are current in our portal and confirm the PO and invoice routing for the upsell (capacity uplift + extended term).

Can you confirm: 
- Which artifacts you can push to our procurement portal (SOC 2 attestation, signed terms, sample SOW)?
- Preferred PO fields and remit-to details so finance can prefill the PO?
- A minimal timeline for evidence upload and approvals if we target a July 1 effective date?

I attached the vendor_requirements.xlsx that our procurement team filled out. Happy to hop on a short call if helpful.

Thanks —
Marcy
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Health
marcy.lewis@acmehealth.com

Attachment: vendor_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 33KB)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcy Lewis <marcy.lewis@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement: portal refresh + timeline

Hi Marcy — thanks for the note and the worksheet. Short answers up front, then a proposed sprint plan below.

- Artifacts we can provide immediately: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), current Data Processing Addendum, and a draft SOW reflecting the capacity uplift.
- PO fields we need: purchase order number, bill-to and remit-to, contact for invoicing, and whether this is a one-time capacity addendum or recurring monthly charge. For ACME we typically accept line-item PO or single-amount PO — whichever your AP team prefers.
- Timeline: if we start onboarding evidence this week and you approve the SOW by 06/09, we can target a July 1 effective date; finance processing typically adds ~7–10 business days after PO issuance.

I've attached a procurement-checklist.pdf with the artifacts we upload to most portals and the minimum attestation redactions. Jordan and Laura — looping you in to confirm SLA amendment language and whether we can pre-generate the DocuSign SOW for signature.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Laura to prepare SOW draft and DocuSign link by 06/08.
2) Jordan to open a ProcurePort ticket for portal upload + confirm required filename formats.
3) Marcy to confirm PO routing and bill-to details by 06/09.

Happy to schedule a 20m sync if that helps move this faster.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachment: procurement-checklist.pdf (document, 78KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement: portal refresh + timeline

FYI / proposed plan from ops side — quick bullets: 
- I'll open ProcurePort ticket today and request pre-validation of filenames (they often want vendorname_doc.pdf). I expect a 24–48h turnaround for initial upload processing.
- For the capacity uplift: suggest we structure as a 12-month term amendment + one-time capacity add-on line item to avoid multiple recurring lines in their ledger.
- SOW: I'll include explicit rollout milestones and an invoice schedule (invoice 50% on execution, 50% on activation) — aligns with our billing practice and gives Acme clear PO support.
- If Acme needs KMS/HSM proof or additional audit logs, call that out now; those take longer to assemble.

Laura — can you confirm you can have the DocuSign SOW ready by EOD 06/08? If yes, I'll attach a prefilled filename and the ticket to the ProcurePort request.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Deal Ops — Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Marcy Lewis <marcy.lewis@acmehealth.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement: portal refresh + timeline

Hi all — DocuSign SOW is ready and prefilled. Link below and I attached the proposed terms doc (redwood-terms-proposed.docx) for your legal review.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/envelopes/ACME-2028-RNW-07

Quick notes:
- SOW includes a one-time capacity addendum (description + quantity) and a 12-month term extension line.
- Invoice schedule in SOW: 50% on execution, 50% on activation (activation = completion of onboarding milestones in SOW).
- Filename we'll upload to ProcurePort: acme_redwood_sow_20280608.pdf and acme_redwood_soc2_redacted_20280608.pdf

Marcy — if ProcurePort requires a contact email field for 'technical liaison', please provide the person who will approve the activation milestone (we can use your onboarding manager or a technical point of contact).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager — Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-terms-proposed.docx (document, 42KB)

From: Marcy Lewis <marcy.lewis@acmehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 11 Jun 2028 09:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement: portal refresh + timeline

Thanks everyone 34 looks good.

Confirming PO routing below (AP verified):
- PO will include purchase_order_number, bill_to: Acme Health Accounts Payable, remit_to: Redwood Inference, 1209 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94103, invoice_contact: ap@acmehealth.com
- Acme will issue a single-amount PO that references the SOW number; payment terms: net 30 from invoice receipt.

We will update ProcurePort today and expect an approvals turnaround ~5 business days. We'll upload the PO once the DocuSign SOW is complete.

Can you attach the redacted SOC 2 and the SOW PDF to the ProcurePort ticket with the filenames Laura suggested? If so, we'll mark the evidence step complete and move to approvals.

Marcy
Senior Procurement Manager, Acme Health
